main_body: Leafy tree canopy (rows ~0-31) on a thin brown trunk with a dark grass/shadow patch at the base
top_band: Canopy top is lit by light-green clumps in the upper right (rows ~5-14). The canopy is a rounded organic volume, not a flat-topped one. A lighter top region sits over darker mid-green and deep-green lower clumps.
evidence: The organic canopy reads as a rounded volume lit from the top-right, with lighter clumps at the top and dark shadowed underside clumps at rows ~20-30 above the trunk. The trunk is a short vertical column that casts a ground shadow. It is not a front elevation or a flat plan. For an organic kind, the lit crown on top with a shaded underside and the trunk below reads as 3/4.

style.evidence: The canopy has about 5 green steps, from pale highlight through mid and dark to deep green, with a dark green outline tinted to the leaves, so it is not a sticker line. The clumps are blocky and large, though, so the leaf texture is coarser than the references' per-leaf dotting. The trunk is a flat 2-3 tone brown column with no bark grain or roots, thinner than the reference trunks with their flared roots and branches. The base shadow patch is nearly flat. Overall it sits a little below the reference in richness and trunk craft.
